stories.title: New mosque in Urbandale sparks heated debate over religious freedom, concerns of Islamic takeover
stories.summary: Many accused the council of letting Sharia Law in, allowing Muslims to take over the community and the government itself.

stories.title: Ames Area MPO seeks student, family input on Safe Routes to School Plan
stories.summary: The Safe Routes to School Plan is asking for parents and students input to improve walking and biking conditions for Ames and Gilbert students.

stories.title: Des Moines considers stricter towing rules to protect vehicle owners
stories.summary: The Des Moines City Council is considering measures to regulate private towing companies.

stories.title: Story City facility expanding to keep up with growing wind energy demands
stories.summary: Generation Repair and Service is working on an expansion project in Story City to keep up with energy demands.

stories.title: Polk County Board of Supervisors approves $1M annually for water quality initiatives
stories.summary: The county said the investment will help it complete more water quality projects through outreach, design and engineering, and construction coordination.

stories.title: Iowa health leaders issue call to action as U.S. loses its measles-elimination status
stories.summary: Leaders say that more people need to get their MMR vaccine to increase herd immunity across the state.

stories.title: Marshalltown firefighters respond to 2 separate kitchen fire over weekend
stories.summary: Unrelated fires on Friday night and Sunday night damaged two Marshalltown homes, the fire department said.

stories.title: Governor-elect Rob Sand names Lanon Baccam inauguration director
stories.summary: Lanon Baccam will serve as inauguration director for the official Sand-Muhlbauer inauguration in January 2027.

stories.title: Baby boy declared Safe Haven, first to be relinquished through Iowa adoption service provider
stories.summary: A baby boy born on Oct. 19 has been declared a Safe Haven baby after he was safely relinquished to an approved Safe Haven adoption service provider.

stories.title: United Airlines resolves system disruption affecting Des Moines International Airport
stories.summary: The disruption impacted travelers for about an hour on Monday afternoon.

stories.title: Gov. Reynolds releases final Iowa Outdoor Recreation Task Force report
stories.summary: The Iowa Outdoor Recreation Task Force identifies areas for growth in Iowa's outdoor recreation industry.

stories.title: Man dies after being shot by Johnston police officer, Iowa DCI investigating
stories.summary: None of the officers involved were injured during the shooting.
